compilerIndexEnumeration.scope: Independent enumeration of compiler bit formulas over 88 indices; not a reread of all native dialogue golds.

designLimitations: thirdQueriesCorrectedEntity and lastQueriesKnownGiver are identical q==u; they are not independently manipulated factors.
Only one giver is disclosed per dialogue; preserving both giver states means preserving one known value and one unknown value, not evidence for retaining two simultaneously known givers.
Seeds cover all16 cells once but not all88 worlds; compiler index enumeration checks the 44/44 balance without claiming full-corpus semantic reading.
This is a bounded synthetic TRAIN-derived contrast; semantic review does not show model competence, natural language generalization or FINAL acceptance.
